component.name: XFB
component.summary: Radio automation, playout and music library management

description.p: XFB is a radio automation and playout system: two decks with crossfades and performance effects, a scheduled programme, a music library with loudness and BPM analysis, jingles and advertising rotation, streaming to Icecast, and a companion app for Android that plays a set off the desk.
It is built to be used without sight. The whole interface is reachable from the keyboard and reported to a screen reader through AT-SPI.

Cover art can be fetched for downloads that never had any; the phone app is offered updates while syncing rather than only at pairing; resuming a download can no longer corrupt a track; and Fedora has a package of its own.
